notes.title: 1225 Content Update Class
notes.content:
[b]The class <Priest> Skills Introduction : [/b]

The priest is a support-oriented class. Various support skills are the indispensable main force in the back row. A strong team gives priority to the goal of protection / fire collection. Excellent cure skill holds the key points to reverse the combat situation.

[u]Magic array - Origin : [/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/3fcbb7980de37a3c731136c380cfa9d3e9fc3b08.png[/img]
This is the basic magic array to heal yourself.

[u]Magic array - Flame : [/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/0c6cd36359bbd0b4bc2a468e643bf28fc1e5b7b3.png[/img]
The array moves forward for a small range, then deal damage over time to all enemies in a small area.

[u]Magic array - Cure : [/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/b6709fcaa8b797c65c778f4bda5aac27a7e3b959.png[/img]
Face to an adjacent ally or empty platform and project the orb to heal a single ally.

[u]Magic array - Holy light : [/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/4bf0f606a39eb4bcad98e0a0923a2e66c06e8afe.png[/img]
The array moves forward for a small range, then heal all allies in a small area over time.

notes.title: 1002 Content Update new class
notes.content:
[b]The class <Guard> Skills Introduction:[/b]

Guard is a class with strong survivability. Although there is only one offensive skill, various defensive skills will greatly increase the counterattack ability of the teammates, and that is often the most headaches on the battlefield.

[u]Basic skill:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/53e8b2c326bdd6cce2a623c71b99a779083c4155.jpg[/img]
The guard’s shield can consume one energy to block any attack from enemy, even if the element is switched. The only drawback is that the shield can’t work when the energy is empty.

[u]Flame shield:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/7f4325f9f9c6822bd90eb6a2b262db35f410896b.jpg[/img]
Summon X-type crossfire column to burn enemies, the distance is very short, but can destroy the magic orb attack from the enemy at the same time

[u]Lightning shield:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/1ac8d05958f37b6b92c690ecba3e2700c94ffe5c.jpg[/img]
Trigger the rune at the front of your visual range, you can create a range area effect, and the allies in this range can gain a buff to avoid once damage.

[u]Frost shield:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34896813/c0922414e3495d0f27a55bcd5c62b628a354c06e.jpg[/img]
Throw a shield to the target that can block any skill/attack for 2 seconds.


The Class for free demo in October : Archer

notes.title: 0731 Update Content
notes.content:
[b]Added class skills tutorial / test scene:[/b]

Now, you can familiarize and practice the class skills you like in this scene.

[b]The class <Archer> Skills Introduction:[/b]

[i]The archer is a class focused on attack. Although there is no means to improve survivability, with the support of a wide range of shooting skills, the attack is actually another type of defense. [/i]

[u]Basic attack: [/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34896813/49ca6b2642ffaf52f8944775217b6b1e16eb9ba0.png[/img]
Under the situation with no buff of elements, the arrow has the advantage of penetrating/ long-range, unless it hits an obstacle and can penetrate all the units hit. 

[u]Flame Arrow: [/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34896813/edebf2e8917e72d8581f88c5b889af292a7a675e.png[/img]
The arrow after the buff of the fire element increases the area damage of the explosion, the shooting curve changes to a parabola and the penetration property is lost. Powerful, but not easy to control, is the favorite of advanced players. 

[u]Lightning arrow: [/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34896813/3721b840b7db0b580f2c8869c0251129c600b819.png[/img]
Sacrifice the range, but split the multiple arrows in three directions. Shots need to rely on luck, but in fact, there are unexpected effects at close range. 

[u]Frost Arrow: [/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34896813/485de10c56af1e14c4ba921b536147a604ee15c0.png[/img]
The archer's only control skill, it can empty the energy when hit the enemy. It is an unexpected killing in the team's battle, and the favorite of the sneak attacker.

notes.title: 06/26 Summer sale update
notes.content:
[b]Simplified operation:[/b]

[u]1. Teleport: [/u]
   Hold the PAD with your left hand and face to the green circle you locked  
   after 1 second.

[u]2. Arrow Skill: [/u]
   Hold the trigger with your left hand and let the bow out. Then hold the 
   trigger with your right hand to pull out the arrow, aim at the target and 
   release the trigger with your right hand to shoot.

[u]3. Mini map switch button: [/u]
   Change to the left-hand Menu button to prevent accidental touch.

[u]4. Mini map skill: [/u]
   Add a system prompt to drop the position of the skill ball.

[b] Game mechanic adjustment: [/b]

[u]1. Victory condition: [/u]
   Destroy the enemy's main Tower.

[u]2. The tower/turret combines with the stronghold and changes the attack 
mechanism: [/u]
   The turret takes the troops as the first priority target, and the player can 
   fight for the time to destroy. Tower will attack player if there is no troops in 
   the turret attack range.

[u]3. New barracks: [/u]
   The barrack also has a turret to help counterattack. After being destroyed, 
   this route stops training troops, and the barrack cannot rebirth, if ignored, 
   the main tower will be quickly destroyed by the troops.

[u]4. Sky City Map Rules: [/u]
   After the game starts, there will be four airship artillery support, at 2.5 
   minutes, 5 minutes, 6.5 minutes, 8 minutes. player of the more strongholds 
   can get support from their own airship, causing 1/3 of the highest health 
   points damage to the enemy's main tower. End a match control within 6-8 
   minutes

[b]Feature addition:[/b]

[u]1. Mission prompt system: [/u]
   First time of you play the game, the system will prompt the player the 
   mission target. This prompt can be closed.

[u]2. Stronghold defense turret reinforcement: [/u]
   The defensive turret will attack the player when there is no troops. And 
   there is a red ray warning before attacking player. The attack of the tower 
   can not be blocked, players need to move their body to dodge tower 
   attacks.

[u]3. Barrack mechanism: [/u]
   There are three barracks in each side. When destroyed, the route stops 
   training troops and cause damage to the main tower at the same time.

[u]4. Arrow skill adjustment: [/u]
   Now you can attack the building and the damage done to the building will 
   be halved.

[u]5.Bots enhancement: [/u]
   Added Bots defense talent, can use shield to block player and tower 
   attacks, and Bots will take the initiative offensive enemy stronghold.

[u]6. Added game lobby function: [/u]
   - The host can kick the player.
   - The host is free to add/remove Bots.
   - Players add mute/reject/block voice features.
   - Introduce the game mechanics of the map after joining the battle room.

[b]Scene optimization:[/b]

1. Adjust the scene material to reduce the graphics load.
2. Adjust the brightness of the scene.
3. Player/troops special effects adjustment.

notes.title: 5/21 Some Bug fix/Content update
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]

1. Character hand and head IK mounting
2. The scoring system is installed, now counts the number of player’s kills, 
    deaths, and troop kills.
3. Increase the animation effect of monster death (with gold coins)
4. Transfer/skill cooling is now prompted
5. Room information in the room list shows the number of players

[b]Optimization:[/b]

1. Optimize the character model
2. Optimize the sense of uncoordinated animation caused by network delay

[b]BUG fix:[/b]

1. Fixed the bug that the archer's illusion did not disappear when dead


[b]Next version update message:[/b]

Thanks for the feedback from the players, we understand that the current version of the MOBA element is too few, the theme is not clear enough.
The next update will add the following contents to make the theme clearer:

1. Both the red and blue troop rebirth points increase the military base, 
    players can attack the building, and the tower will take the initiative attack 
    the player.
2. The main tower HP will be linked with the three strongholds. After the 
    player breaks the military base, the opponent will stop producing the 
    troops.
3. The airship will be fired at regular intervals (the one occupying more 
    strongholds)
4. Towers and buildings will indicate HP and add attack and destruction 
    animations.
